ja310:1.1: Sasamuddapariyāyaṃ mahiṃ sāgarakuṇḍalaṃ na icche saha nindāya, evaṃ Sayha vijānahi.
ja310:2.1: Dhi-r-atthu naṃ yasalābhaṃ dhanalābhañ ca brāhmaṇa (cfr. Supra. p. yā vutti vinipātena adhammacaraṇena vā.
ja310:3.1: Api ce pattam ādāya anāgāro paribbaje sā eva jīvikā seyyo yā cādhammena esanā.
ja310:4.1: Api ce pattam ādāya anāgāro paribbaje aññaṃ ahiṃsayaṃ loke api rajjena taṃ varan ti.
